comment: The suites scripts/db-conformance.mjs runs against a real database.
A part's named invariant suite goes in `invariant`; the conformance suites
its change affects go in `conformance`. Both are paths from the repository
root. The runner fails when a named suite is missing, when any test in one
of them is skipped, and when a run ends with zero tests having executed.
Filled from the L1-TENANCY and L2-AUTHORITY handbacks: the pooled crossover,
the prefix harness and L2's identity, delegation, comment, preset-plan and
settings suites are the invariants; the first three conformance suites are the
catalogue, wrapper and runtime-statement proofs. statement-log.test.ts is
a pure unit suite and must not be named (it moves the database counter by 0).
L3-SURFACE adds the surface-operations suite (task.comment, preset.plan, settings, audited reads, D06); L4-RUNTIME adds the gate and lease suites (G01-G04, G06, G07, W01-W06, I07).
L2-FIX adds the comment-type upgrade, the login-kind race and the preset family suites.

L3-PART-B adds the task-runtime suite (propose/decide through the envelope, replay, the G03 recorded refusal, the runtime-refusal rollback, the proposal projection) and the agent-path suite (I12, I07: the pre-pickup pair, the one-task ceiling, the decision exclusion, the handback settlement, the agent-actor audit). runtime-codes.test.ts is a pure unit suite and must not be named.

L3-PART-B-2 adds the task-runtime-routes suite (the five routes and both prefixes over HTTP, the retained-report refusal, the in-process restart), the cli-reach suite (every declaration through the generated client) and the surface-reads suite (settings.read, session.capabilities, audited reads with a null subject, D06 on the read half); L4-RUNTIME-FIX's review-fixes suite (R1-R10 regressions on a real database) is named with it. handback-expenditure.test.ts is a pure unit suite and must not be named.
L4-RUNTIME-FIX-2 adds the classifier-race suite (R1's executed two-classifier race) and the decision-abort suite (R2's forced post-write reservation refusal).
See docs/agents/database-conformance.md.
SPINE-UPGRADE adds the visibility-upgrade suite (SURFACE-R-1: an installed spine reconciles title and state to the I09 shared class, nothing else moves, a second install writes nothing).

BOUNDARY-FIXES adds the four boundary suites (root rulings 1, 3, 4 and 5 and I14-SEAM U1: installed system-field keys at the top level, read targets and the task.board operand, the non-object-body admission refusal, effective-grant capabilities).

L5-PROOFS adds four acceptance suites (the generated exported-surface inventory, the six-role nine-case matrix, the protected set on three surfaces, the four-state predicate/RLS mutation proof); each runs in process against the real application. restart-and-expiry.test.ts is NOT named: its container-restart case is a guarded skip (L5_RESTART_CONTAINER_NAME, or the older L5_RESTART_CONTAINER=1) and the runner refuses a skipped test, so the coordinator runs that leg explicitly with the flag as its own step. world.ts, cast.ts, restart-harness.ts and role-case-*.ts are harnesses, not suites.

L3-PART-B-3 adds the settings-revision-routes suite (the two settings commands and settings.read by revision over in-process Hono), the envelope-faults suite (the omitted operationId and the two task.propose shapes over in-process Hono) and the settings-revision suite (the same three writes through executeCommand). handback-successor.test.ts is a pure unit suite and must not be named.

RUNTIME-LIFECYCLE adds the five lifecycle suites (cancellation closes delegation and run, stale-version handback refused with retained report, proposal/handback lock order, cancel race, authority-loss classification) and control-scope (cancel/restart authorised on their own target); W-SCHEDULES adds the W01 before/after-commit, W03 handback-versus-proposal, W05 competing-reservation and eight-hour heartbeat schedules through the real command entry.

PERSON-WORK adds person-work-http (EX-01 person pickup, renewal and handback on the person route, wrong-owner and lost-rights refusals) and person-work-schedules (grant.revoke against pickup, R5 fresh replacement, three competing claimants, an agent on a person's lease of its own task).

AUTHORITY-LOSS adds authority-loss-person-lease (grant.revoke classifies a person's own lease, write as work authority, the run back to planned, revoke responses listing classified holds, replay exactly once) and gate-reason-lineage (task.propose and task.restart answer a foreign and a fabricated lineage id byte-identically, audited at home).

PICKUP-REPLAY adds pickup-replay-lost-response (a lost pickup response replayed with the same derived credential and handles under current rights, lease and approval binding, no plaintext token or key bytes stored) and pickup-replay-keys (fixed HMAC encoding, keyring parsing and provisioning, rotation with retained read keys, closed failure on a missing key or corrupt metadata, legacy rows kept legacy).

DECISION-V3 names verified-decisions (the chain, payload and key checks on the proposal read) and decision-v3 (columns bound to the signed payload on v1, v2 and v3 with the unkeyed chain recomputed: a fabricated signer, a transplanted approval, every v3 field and link, the per-format signedFields label, and the pinned v3 bytes).

OWN-LEASE-SCOPE adds own-lease-record-scope (task.pickup, task.heartbeat and task.handback authorised on the task their reservation or lease belongs to: a record-scoped writer works their own lease, the sibling task and a fabricated id answer byte-identically, the strand case renews and hands back).

CLI-ENTRY adds cli-process (the runnable command line as separate OS processes against the real apps/api/server.ts on a free port: the person journey with revisions checked in the database, board and people reads, SCOPE_NOT_GRANTED, another business, an unknown verb with no request, the agent queue/pickup/heartbeat/handback with the saved delegation credential, a bare agent call, login's password grant, and the package script). cli-delegation-replay (Sol 6 SURFACE-1: a replayed handback of lease A, sent with A's credential from the environment, leaves lease B's saved credential in the file, and it still authorises B's heartbeat and handback) runs on the same harness. cli-process-harness.ts is a harness, not a suite; mounted-cli.test.ts stays unnamed because it needs SURFACE_API_PORT.

Also named: statement-capture-full, the fourth conformance suite (T04 and M03 over every operation); restricted-calls and restricted-calls-prefixes (I06 and M02 at the full schema and at every prefix, on seeded rows); production-lookup (I14 on the shipped lockTask, mutated on a disposable source copy); operand-refusals, capabilities-shape, unproduced-reach, gate-expiry, decision-integrity-read, controls-revoke, controls-work, web-reads, expiry-bound and the two external-party suites (R4); gate-negatives, model-negatives and gate-not-found; identifier-negatives (foreign, fabricated and same-business refusals compared by status and raw response bytes) and audit-per-operation (I13 and I08, and a non-object body recorded as one authentication_attempts row with no audit_events row, on both prefixes); authority-loss-narrowed, runtime-residuals and lease-held-reach.

DB-PROOF-GAPS-B adds l6-schedules (W02 b same-operationId pickup retry in flight, W04 pickup x task.cancel both orders and pickup x expired-lease replacement, each on two backends with observed parking), l6-cases (G04 superseded hold not claimable, G05 rulings 3 and 4, W05 BUDGET_UNAVAILABLE), restart-expiry-bound (task.restart at and one over seven days through the route) and heartbeat-bound (W02 c, the heartbeat maximum and one over).

Not named: tests/api/server-onerror.test.ts and tests/cli/mounted-cli.test.ts skip every case unless SURFACE_API_PORT names a spare loopback port for the real server they spawn, and the runner refuses a skip, so each runs as its own step with the port set.

G3-CASES adds grant-chain (a two-level manager chain through the grant writer: GRANT_WIDENS, GRANT_DEEPENS, and grant.revoke on the root biting the grandchild's next call beside a live sibling chain), agent-bare-handback-replay (a credential-free task.handback replay refused DELEGATION_EXCLUDES_OPERATION with nothing of the receipt and no state change) and decision-never-delegated (delegations_never_decide and the not-null decided_by_person_id, as the application role).

L3-RETENTION adds purge-retention (task.purge reads each business's retention_window_days inside its own transaction: two businesses with different windows and trash an hour either side, evidence untouched, a caller olderThanDays of any value refused COMMAND_BODY_INVALID with no mutation and one refused audit row, replay of an applied purge, a window of zero purging one business's trash only).

ID-OPERANDS adds id-operand-shape (a malformed id, "" and "not-a-uuid", against a fabricated uuid for every id operand on both prefixes: agent task.pickup, task.heartbeat and task.handback answer the fabricated refusal byte for byte instead of the uuid fault, person task.pickup, task.heartbeat and task.handback in the operation's own code, one refused audit row and no state change for each form, a numeric agent reservationId, and a valid pickup as the positive control).

PROOF-CLOSURE names d06-generated (D06 on the API, CLI and web person surfaces, every cell between a succeeding positive control and a succeeding clean retry, the person's own pickup, renewal and handback included) and d06-agent (D06 on the agent route).

AGENT-BOUNDARY adds agent-capabilities-intersection (agent session.capabilities reports the current intersection of purpose and the delegating person's effective grants: write absent once its grant expires, DELEGATION_NARROWED when nothing is held, and a replay under another delegation's credential never releases the first scope) and historical-handback-intake (a superseded or expired agent's new handback keeps one retained handback_reports row and one refused audit row and still answers DELEGATION_NOT_LIVE; wrong lease, fence or credential retain nothing; settled replay stays the replay), and names the existing capabilities-contract and agent-system-fields suites.

DB-PROOF-GAPS-A adds wrapper-mutation (T04 a and b: database.ts:105 made session-wide and moved before begin on a source copy, each red on the capture shape of real operations beside the unmutated copy; T04 c: the DECISION_INTEGRITY read captured as begin, local setting, work, rollback; T05: the session-wide mutant red at pooled-crossover's :168 and :206 reads, green on the restored wrapper), decision-signature-only (G02 a: only gate_decisions.signature altered, with and without the unkeyed chain recomputed, faults DECISION_INTEGRITY; restored, it reads) and decision-seq-race (G02 b: two approvals with room, parked on the chain lock on two backends, land at consecutive seq each linked to the row before).

RECOVERY-ENTRY adds recovery-entry (TC84/92 through the real apps/api/server.ts process with RECOVERY_BUSINESS_KEYS: an eligible recorded transition classified once before readiness, a second start subtracting nothing, an injected pre-commit fault rolled back with exit 1 and completed on the next start, claimable and unfenced-live holds untouched and a marked hold kept whole, only the configured business changed, two racing starts releasing each hold once).

AGENT-BOUNDARY-2 adds agent-pickup-payload (W02 a: person and agent pickup answers field by field against their rows, and the handbackShape derived from task.handback), and extends historical-handback-intake to a narrowed agent (DELEGATION_NARROWED keeps one retained report) with second-agent, cross-business, forged, lease, fence, replay and rollback controls on both paths.

ACCEPTANCE-ROWS names i10-inflight (I10: a read admitted and held open in its transaction while grant.revoke commits, then refused on the next call) and board-not-found (task.board on a foreign, fabricated or malformed board refused, never an empty success), the two suites L6 section 9 item 13 left unnamed for this lane; role-case-matrix now carries a named (c)/(d) row for all 35 operations and I07 on one live gate, and identifier-negatives the SC2 audit (9/9 at home, none in bravo). It adds identifier-timing (I04: 26 identifier-bearing operations, 30 alternating foreign/fabricated pairs after 5 discarded, Mann-Whitney |z| <= 3.29 or a median bound of max(2 ms, 20 percent), and a 15 ms injected delay flagged). cd-alternatives.ts is a harness, not a suite.

RETRY-BOUNDS adds retry-bounds (the terminal side of both bounded retries: task.cancel losing its discovery on both attempts, two command transactions and one failed-audit transaction; an agent pickup losing operations_identity_key on both attempts, staged because no schedule reaches it, two transactions and no audit event; grant.revoke taking its grant row before any runtime lock, with the waiters observed while a pickup is parked).

SOL-RUNTIME-FIX adds cap-exact-and-post-lock-clock (Sol 6 RUNTIME-1 to 3 through the command entry: a USD version under an AUD cap refused CAP_BINDING_MISMATCH with nothing moved; a cap of 2^53 + 1 filled exactly and one more unit refused BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, totals read as SQL text; a decide parked on its gate and a heartbeat parked on its lease past the deadline refused GATE_EXPIRED and LEASE_EXPIRED with no decision and no changed lease or delegation expiry).

SOL-AUTHORITY-FIX adds non-member-grants (R4 against provisioned record-scoped comment and write grants: alone they are no standing, beside a read share they write no team note and no update, the client audience only on a held comment grant, the shared projection unchanged) and agent-operation-id (a number, array, null or absent agent operationId is OPERATION_ID_REQUIRED with no register row; the string registers), and extends historical-handback-intake with actualMinor 1 on the narrowed, retired and grant-expired paths (ACTUAL_EXPENDITURE_UNSUPPORTED, nothing retained).

RETRY-GAPS adds retry-gaps (task.propose meeting a pickup of the superseded hold and grant.revoke meeting a handback of a dependent lease, each forced between discovery and locks, answer the first request after one retry; propose losing twice answers AffectedSetChanged after two attempts with nothing committed; the unreachable handback binding recheck is proved typed and bounded by a rewritten read).

COMMAND-CATALOGUE adds stray-identifiers (a stray identifier on task.heartbeat, task.cancel, task.restart, grant.revoke and delegation.revoke is refused COMMAND_BODY_INVALID with nothing written; architecture observation 2).

THERMO-RUNTIME adds recovery-replay-pin (replay's eligible set unchanged when discovery is shared) and pickup-refusal-order (the ruled O6 order: approval refused before any replacement write), both against a real database.

SOL6-RUNTIME-FIX-2 adds lease-expiry-post-lock-clock (Sol 6 RUNTIME-1 at 158d6de through the command entry: a handback parked on the cap past its lease expiry refused LEASE_EXPIRED, its report retained, lease, hold, envelope, gates and versions unchanged; a person pickup parked on the cap past the bound lease's expiry fences it, classifies the old hold lease_expired_and_fenced and opens exactly one fresh hold, its lease running from the post-lock instant); and successor-bounds-exact (Sol 6 RUNTIME-2: a cap of 2^54 + 3 with 2^54 + 1 committed through valid holds, a successor ceiling of 4 refused SUCCESSOR_OUT_OF_BOUNDS with no report, no successor and nothing moved, and a ceiling of 2 accepted with a pending successor gate).

SOL6-AUTHORITY-FIX-2 adds person-replay-current-rights (a person replay of a stored success answers current authority: pickup after the only covering write grant is revoked is SCOPE_NOT_GRANTED with no receipt, no second lease and the register row unchanged; a pickup whose lease was handed back is LEASE_EXPIRED; task.create after revocation is refused; live rights replay as stored; Sol 6 AUTHORITY-1).

SOL6-AUTHORITY-FIX-2 adds agent-operand-types (on the agent prefix an array reservationId is COMMAND_BODY_INVALID with no lease, a string fence or array outcome is FIELD_VALUE_INVALID with the lease live and no report, and after the person's write grant lapses an array outcome retains nothing; string ids, numeric fences and string outcomes still claim, settle and retain; Sol 6 AUTHORITY-2), and sends agent-person-wording's pickup and handback rows the same full body on both entries.

SOL6-AUTHORITY-FIX-2 adds agent-read-targets (on the agent prefix a stray recordId on task.queue or session.capabilities and a stray board on task.read is COMMAND_BODY_INVALID naming the field, one body for own, foreign and fabricated ids, one refused audit event per call, before the delegation is read and in the person prefix bytes; the reads without it answer 200; Sol 6 AUTHORITY-3).

THERMO-FIX-AGENT adds agent-record-shape (THERMO-RECHECK-2 NNA1: on the agent prefix a recordId that is present and not a string, an array, a nested array, an object, a number, a boolean or null naming a sibling task, is refused before any authority in the person prefix bytes, NOT_FOUND on task.comment and FIELD_VALUE_INVALID on task.read, with one refused audit row, no state change and no comment on the sibling; the agent's own task and a string sibling are the controls).

THERMO-FIX-AGENT adds pickup-receipt-binding (THERMO-RECHECK-2 NNA2: the one pickup-replay binding step both entries take, on a real stored agent receipt: its holder under its own delegation gets the credential columns; no delegation, another agent's delegation or another holder is LEASE_NOT_OWNED).

SOL6-RUNTIME-FIX-2 adds lease-expiry-post-lock-clock (Sol 6 RUNTIME-1 at 158d6de through the command entry: a handback parked on the cap past its lease expiry refused LEASE_EXPIRED, its report retained, lease, hold, envelope, gates and versions unchanged; a person pickup parked on the cap past the bound lease's expiry fences it, classifies the old hold lease_expired_and_fenced and opens exactly one fresh hold, its lease running from the post-lock instant; the same agent's replacement parked the same way settles its expired delegation instead of refusing DELEGATION_ALREADY_LIVE); and successor-bounds-exact (Sol 6 RUNTIME-2: a cap of 2^54 + 3 with 2^54 + 1 committed through valid holds, a successor ceiling of 4 refused SUCCESSOR_OUT_OF_BOUNDS with no report, no successor and nothing moved, and a ceiling of 2 accepted with a pending successor gate); its continuation adds handback-envelope-totals (thermo NB5: a marked attempt's handback answers the quarantined 1500 held from the envelope row, not a 0 fallback).

PROTECTED-MIGRATIONS adds cap-storage-backstop (migrations 0024 and 0025 through the application role, on a fresh database and on one seeded at 0023 then upgraded: a USD envelope under an AUD cap, a cap currency change beneath an envelope and an envelope moved to another currency or cap refused by task_envelopes_cap_currency_fkey; a cap filled to exactly its ceiling, then one unit more on hold, on actual, by insert, by lowering the limit and by the second of two open transactions that each fit alone refused budget_caps_ceiling at commit; seeded rows unchanged by the upgrade; a 0023 database holding a mismatched or over-ceiling row stops before the rule with the row untouched).

CAP-RR extends cap-storage-backstop (Sol 6 SURFACE-R-2: two application-role transactions whose snapshots both saw room under one cap, each raise fitting alone, together over it; at read committed the second is refused budget_caps_ceiling, at repeatable read and serializable it is refused serialization_failure, and the committed total stays within the cap on fresh and upgraded databases).

OWNER-RULINGS-FIX adds comment-rulings (Nathan's first-slice rulings over HTTP: a delegated agent's client-audience comment refused AUDIENCE_NOT_PERMITTED 422 on the agent prefix and AUTH_NO_MEMBERSHIP 403 on the person prefix, its internal note written, nothing else written; a comment on a trashed task refused NOT_FOUND 404 on both entries in the bytes of an identifier nothing carries, no comment written) and moves external-party to the I09 ruling (a shared task shows its client the title and the state's label).

ARCH-4 adds rediscovery-pin (the statement sequence from the first unlocked discovery to the end of the recheck at propose, cancel, delegation.revoke, grant.revoke and the startup replay, taken before those sites moved onto one rediscovery module; propose's window gains its held-set recheck with O3), and o3-held-recheck (thermo O3: task.propose meeting an approval of the version it supersedes, forced between discovery and locks, and a rejection meeting a hold revived by a test write in the same window, each answer the first request after one AffectedSetChanged retry with the hold classified under the right cause and nothing written by the lost attempt).

THERMO-FIX-RUNTIME adds successor-bounds-edge (thermo NB1 at 9d2dbde through the command entry: with 2 units of cap room, a successor ceiling of 3 and a successor in USD under an AUD cap are each refused SUCCESSOR_OUT_OF_BOUNDS in their exact bytes with no report retained and nothing moved, and a ceiling of exactly 2 is accepted).

FR1-DBTEST (final review R1 #49) names the 23 database-bound suites that no required context ran: tests/api/{admission-enumeration,agent-operation-id,surface-operations}, tests/commands/{agent-operands,agent-operation-order,agent-replay-auth,audit-chain,command-shape,command-surface,concurrency,create-authority,local-slice,lost-update,task-fields,task-lifecycle,task-trash-commands}, tests/identity/{identifier-resolution,login-resolution}, tests/records/{records-integrity,slot-law} and tests/tasks/{task-model,task-spine,task-trash}. The tests/api and tests/commands files named agent-operation-id and surface-operations are different suites, and both copies are named. It adds final-r1-dbtest-triggers (#64: the 0010 proposal_versions and 0014 attempts triggers, each branch broken on purpose as the application role and as the owner, with the permitted writes as the control) and final-r1-dbtest-manifest, the guard that fails when a suite reaching fresh-database.ts is neither named nor listed here as unnamed; that guard is a pure unit suite and must not be named.

Not named, because each skips without a variable the runner does not set and the runner refuses a skip: restart-http.test.ts (W06 over HTTP, needs L5_RESTART_CONTAINER_NAME and L5_RESTART_API_PORT, run beside restart-and-expiry by pnpm verify:restart) and pickup-replay-restart.test.ts (a lost pickup across an API and Postgres restart, needs PICKUP_REPLAY_API_PORT and PICKUP_REPLAY_PG_CONTAINER). Not named because they are pure unit suites that import a harness module reaching fresh-database.ts but open no database: restart-declared.test.ts (restart-harness refusals), cli-answers.test.ts and cli-wire.test.ts (the real CLI against an HTTP stand-in, through cli-process-harness), and global-setup.test.ts (besideUrl only).

FR1-DBTEST-CONT names the merged FR1 lanes' database-bound suites: final-r1-fr1-jsonb-comment and final-r1-fr1-jsonb (FR1-JSONB), final-r1-api-sign-ambiguous-key (FR1-API-SIGN), final-r1-fr1-trash (FR1-TRASH), final-r1-place and final-r1-place-reach (FR1-PLACE) and final-r1-fr1-runtime (FR1-RUNTIME). Not named: final-r1-cli.test.ts is a pure unit suite (it moves the counter by 0 and its terminal case skips without a terminal). final-r1-api-sign-read.test.ts is left out for now, because it fails at the integration head 83accc6: its fixture decides with an object note, which FR1-RUNTIME's #53 fix refuses FIELD_VALUE_INVALID (packages/core-runtime/src/decide.ts:74-75). It is named once its owner lane reconciles the two.

FR1-DBTEST-CONT adds final-r1-dbtest-seed-revoke (#60: scripts/local-seed.mjs run as its own process on a fresh database refuses to revoke a grant that is the work authority for a live lease, naming the grant and what to do instead, and leaves the grant and the lease as they were).

FR1-DBTEST-CONT-2 names final-r1-fr1-agent, final-r1-fr1-agent-delegation-widens and final-r1-fr1-agent-merge-cycle (FR1-AGENT), final-r1-place-owned (FR1-PLACE-CONT), final-r1-fr1-jsonb-cont (FR1-JSONB-CONT) and final-r1-fr1-runtime-cont (FR1-RUNTIME-CONT), and now final-r1-api-sign-read: FR1-RUNTIME-CONT-2 rebuilt its fixture as a signed stored row, so the unnamed reason recorded above no longer holds.

FR1-DBTEST-CONT-3 names final-r1-fr1-migrations as an invariant (FR1-MIGRATIONS: the storage backstops of 0026 to 0028, #63 no actual reservation in the first head, #24 a business key unique across businesses, #55 no delete on identity history, on fresh and upgraded databases), and final-r1-fr1-jsonb-settings and final-r1-fr1-jsonb-cont-3 (FR1-JSONB continuations 2 and 3).

FR2-DBTEST names final-r2-dbtest-cap-fails-closed as an invariant (migration 0029, R2-RUNTIME-6 = R2-AUTHORITY-20: an envelope inserted, a hold raised or a limit lowered by the application role, then app.business_id cleared or switched to another business before commit, is refused budget_caps_ceiling past the ceiling and within it, because a hidden cap is not room; the same writes under a steady setting commit within the ceiling and are refused past it; on a fresh database and on one seeded at 0028 then upgraded, with the seeded rows unchanged).

FR2-DBTEST-CONT names the round-2 lanes' database-bound suites. Invariant: final-r2-fr2-api-temporary (FR2-API, R2-AUTHORITY-61: the application role holds no TEMPORARY, and default deny notices a grant of it). Conformance: final-r2-fr2-trash (FR2-TRASH: restore takes the parent lock, purge of comments, grants, recheck and ids, the long window), final-r2-fr2-trash-cont (FR2-TRASH-CONT: revokeShare on a trashed task, with refusal controls), final-r2-fr2-api-capabilities (FR2-API: R4 session.capabilities offers only usable pairs, and person.list), final-r2-fr2-api-settings-revision (FR2-API: a non-integer settings expectedRevision is refused 422 FIELD_VALUE_INVALID), final-r2-fr2-api-agent-deactivation (FR2-API: the agent door refuses a deactivated actor or mapping), final-r2-fr2-propose and final-r2-fr2-propose-restart (FR2-PROPOSE and its continuation: the propose refusals, and a restart naming a sibling task's lineage answered by the task guard without either id), final-r2-place (FR2-PLACE: placement), final-r2-fr2-runtime, final-r2-fr2-runtime-cont and final-r2-fr2-runtime-integrity (FR2-RUNTIME and its continuation; the continuation reaches the database through the controls fixture), and final-r2-fr2-jsonb and final-r2-fr2-jsonb-external (FR2-JSONB). Not named: final-r2-fr2-api-keyring, final-r2-cli, final-r2-fr2-jsonb-values and final-r2-fr2-docs are unit suites, and the three tests/surfaces final-r2 suites are jsdom only; none reaches fresh-database.ts.
FR2-DBTEST-CONT-2 names final-r2-place-cont as a conformance suite (FR2-PLACE continuation: placement lock order, move rank, rank neighbour case).

FR2-DBTEST-0030 names final-r2-dbtest-gate-pack-binding as an invariant (migration 0030, FR2-P2: as the application role, a decided gate pointed at another version's pack, a decided gate moved onto a superseded version with its own run, step and pack, and a gate inserted naming another version's pack are refused gates_pack_in_same_version or gates_version_fixed_once_decided with nothing moved; the runtime's propose, approve, reject and request-changes-then-approve still commit; on a fresh database and on one seeded at 0029 then upgraded, with the seeded rows unchanged; a 0029 database holding any of the three stops before 0030 with its rows untouched). final-r2-fr2-runtime-integrity case (c) now asserts that storage refusal and proves the read check with the owner's move.

FR2-DBTEST-0031 names final-r2-dbtest-upgrade-guards as an invariant (migration 0031, FR2-P3, SOL-R3-2 and SOL-R3-1 on databases built at 0028 and migrated: TEMPORARY held at 0028 by PUBLIC, the application group or the application login is refused to the login after the upgrade; a cap committed past its ceiling through the old 0025 hole, with the setting cleared or switched, refuses the upgrade with rows unchanged and 0031 not recorded; a valid 0028 database and a fresh one migrate cleanly).

FR2-DBTEST-CONT-3 names the round-3 lanes' database-bound suites, all as conformance (behavioural fixes, as round 2's were): final-r3-propose (FR3-PROPOSE: SOL-R3-3 envelope room at propose, with controls; R3-AUTHORITY-20 lineage-on-task before pricing; R3-AUTHORITY-19 upper-case lineageId; R2-RUNTIME-26 (b) restart against the business cap; it reaches fresh-database.ts through openSchedules), final-r3-place (FR3-PLACE: a restored subtask takes its live parent's board; a trash through an ancestor takes a child created or restored meanwhile; one sibling lock per id however it is cased; task.move to its own board in upper case), final-r3-decide (FR3-DECIDE: a non-string versionId, parentId, board or boardSection refused by name at the typed-identifier door rather than 503, and the replayed reparent's authority re-judgement, R3-AUTHORITY-6 = R3-RUNTIME-7 = R3-SURFACE-9, R2-AUTHORITY-33, R1-RUNTIME-53, R3-SURFACE-8, R3-THERMO-25) and final-r3-decide-seed-race (FR3-DECIDE, R1-AUTHORITY-60: the seed takes the dropped grants for update first, so it waits for an in-flight pickup and sees its lease rather than revoking the grant under it).

FR3R-0030 names final-r3r-0030-upgrade-race as an invariant (migration 0030, SOL-R3R-1: on a database seeded at 0029 through the runtime, the application role's move of a decided gate onto a superseded version with its own run, step and pack, made while 0030 is paused after its check block, waits for 0030 and is refused gates_version_fixed_once_decided with the gate on its decided version; the same move in flight when the upgrade starts makes the upgrade wait, then refuses the upgrade at 0029). R4-THERMO-4 adds two cases to final-r2-dbtest-gate-pack-binding, one per trigger guard: (d) a decided gate reset to pending and then moved, refused by the decision guard alone, and (e) a superseded gate with no decision moved, refused by the state guard alone.

FR5-0030 adds two cases to final-r3r-0030-upgrade-race (SOL-R3R2-1): a real propose on a database at 0029, held between its evidence pack and its gate (a first version) or between superseding the old gate and its pack (a successor), while 0030 starts as the runner applies it. Both must commit, with 0030 recorded, its pack key validated and the gate on its own version's pack. Unedited, 0030 deadlocked with the first; locking evidence_packs before gates deadlocks with the second; 0030 now locks proposal_versions first.

FR6-RUNNER names final-r6-runner-guard as an invariant (the migration runner, owner ruling 2026-09-24: with a migration pending, a held application-login session or any other client backend on the database refuses the run, naming each by pid, login, application, address and start, with the ledger and schema unchanged; it applies once they close; an up-to-date database with the application connected passes; a session that connects inside a migration is caught by the check before its commit; db-migrate.mjs refuses and exits 2 with no bypass). The caller suites that seed through their own pools now close them first (EmptyDatabase.closeSessions), with assertions unchanged.
